samples.question: A reference cluster of three dark dots is shown in the box at the top of the image. The spread of a cluster is the distance between the two dots in it that are farthest apart (its widest extent). The image below the box is split into four quadrants, each holding its own cluster of three dark dots. Exactly one quadrant's cluster has the SAME spread as the reference cluster; the other three each have a clearly different spread. Which quadrant contains the cluster whose spread matches the reference cluster? Answer with one quadrant name.
